column3: NKJV has “we were gentle,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “we were infants,” which a one-letter difference distinguishes. In the critical text, part of verse 6 begins verse 7.
NKJV has “their own prophets,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the prophets.”
NKJV has “our Lord Jesus Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “our Lord Jesus.”
